Faen.description: Attuned to the wilds and whispers between worlds, the Faen carry grace in their blood and secrets in their silence.
Faen.flavor: Rare and ethereal, Faen are often viewed with awe or unease in civilized lands.

Kindred.description: Adaptable and ambitious, the Kindred are the most widespread of the mortal peoples — unburdened by magic, but driven by will.
Kindred.flavor: Seen as the default race in many cultures, Kindred often hold positions of power or influence.

Emberkin.description: Born of fire and bound to legacy, Emberkin possess an intensity that walks the line between brilliance and destruction.
perks: Magic manifests as hearthfire, bonfire, or wildfire — unpredictable, but powerful
Emberkin.flavor: Mistrusted in many circles due to their origins, Emberkin often find themselves proving — or embracing — the stories whispered about them.
